title: Mushroom Tostadas
description: Mushroom Tostadas feature crispy corn tortillas topped with savory sautéed mixed mushrooms, a creamy lime topping, crumbled queso fresco, and fresh garnishes. This vegetarian Mexican dish is full of earthy flavors, vibrant textures, and restaurant-quality presentation.

ingredients.title: For the Tostadas
items: Small corn tortillas – 4
Vegetable oil – 2 tbsp (for frying) or use oven-baked method for crispier tortillas

ingredients.title: For the Mushroom Filling
items: Mixed mushrooms (cremini, shiitake, oyster), sliced – 400 g (about 14 oz)
Unsalted butter – 2 tbsp
Olive oil – 1 tbsp
Small shallot, finely diced – 1
Garlic cloves, minced – 2
Smoked paprika – 1 tsp
Ground cumin – ½ tsp
Salt and freshly ground black pepper – to taste
Soy sauce – 1 tbsp (optional, for umami depth)
Fresh lime juice – 1 tbsp

ingredients.title: For the Creamy Topping
items: Mexican crema or sour cream – 100 g (½ cup)
Lime zest – 1 tsp
Smoked chili powder (chipotle or ancho) – ½ tsp

ingredients.title: For Garnishes
items: Crumbled queso fresco or Cotija cheese – ½ cup
Microgreens or cilantro leaves – ¼ cup
Radishes, thinly sliced – 2
Pickled red onions (optional)
Drizzle of high-quality extra virgin olive oil

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Tostadas
steps: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. Fry tortillas 1–2 minutes per side until golden and crispy.
Alternative: Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 8–10 minutes, brushing lightly with oil for crunch.
Drain on paper towels and set aside.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Sauté the Mushrooms
steps: In a large skillet, heat butter and olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add shallots, sauté 2–3 minutes until soft and translucent.
Add garlic, cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add mushrooms, season with smoked paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper. Sauté until mushrooms release their moisture and become golden brown (~6–8 minutes).
Stir in soy sauce (optional) and lime juice. Adjust seasoning. Remove from heat.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Make the Creamy Topping
steps: Mix crema with lime zest and smoked chili powder in a small bowl. Adjust to taste.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Assemble the Tostadas
steps: Spread a thin layer of the crema mixture on each crispy tortilla.
Sprinkle with crumbled cheese, radishes, microgreens, and pickled onions.
Finish with a light drizzle of extra virgin olive oil and an extra squeeze of lime if desired.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve immediately while the tostadas are crisp.
Pair with Mexican rice, black beans, or a fresh salad.
Enjoy with salsa verde, guacamole, and lime wedges.

chefTips: Use a mix of mushrooms for earthy depth and visual appeal.
Don't overcrowd the pan while sautéing mushrooms; you want them to brown, not steam.
Make the tostadas just before serving for maximum crunch.
Garnish with microgreens and a drizzle of olive oil for elevated plating.
For extra flavor, lightly toast the tortillas on an open flame before frying or baking—they gain a smoky aroma.
